title: NekoDAO
tagline: Generate unique NFTs with AI, track their history on-chain, and contribute to existing creations✨
description:
Our platform makes creating NFTs easier and more exciting by using AI and blockchain technology. You can generate unique AI-powered NFTs and keep track of their history on-chain, including image data, AI prompts, and creator info. Plus, you can build on existing NFTs with generative AI, making it a collaborative and creative space. 

Transferring NFTs is simple, with support for paying gas fees in either ETH or USDC. Built on the modern ERC-1155 standard and powered by the MultiBaas SDK for seamless deployment, our platform runs on efficient blockchains like Polygon and Base.
how_its_made:
We referred to Curvegrid’s MultiBaas sample app to build our NFT contract, aiming to design a metadata structure that records the creation process—allowing contributors to participate in crafting an NFT and be recognized, while also enabling users to trace how an NFT was created through specific prompts or elements, inspiring further innovative creations.

We also used Account Abstraction to integrate Circle’s USDC Paymaster, allowing users to purchase NFTs and pay gas fees using USDC.
